name: sync_mode
description: Enables synchronous rendering mode for debugging purposes.

name: log_file_path
description: Set the path to the log file for logging output.

name: log_level
description: Set the log level for logging output (e.g. "verbose", "info", "warn", "error").

name: enable_profiling
description: Enable internal profiling. Adds overhead when enabled.

name: read_gpu_transforms
description: Use GPU world transform propagation during rendering.

name: keep_system_alive
description: Keep the renderer system alive after all instances are destroyed so the next create reuses it. When omitted (`None`), the native layer defaults to enabled.

name: active_cuda_gpus
description: Comma-separated CUDA device indices to use for rendering (e.g., "0,1,2").

name: datastore_cache
description: Protocol-prefixed datastore cache configuration used by UJITSO. Supported values include `grpcdns://host:port`, `grpcdns_notls://host:port`, and `local://path`. When omitted, existing defaults and environment-variable behavior are preserved.

name: selection_outline_enabled
description: Enable the selection-outline post-process pass. Defaults to `True` when unset. Init-time only; toggling requires recreating the renderer.

name: selection_outline_width
description: Selection outline width in pixels. Valid range is `0..15` (the underlying RTX outline pipeline cap); out-of-range values are clamped by the renderer. Init-time only; changing requires recreating the renderer. Default: 2.

name: selection_fill_mode
description: Selection-outline fill (interior) mode. Accepts a :class:`SelectionFillMode` member or the equivalent `int` value (`0..3`). Out-of-range values raise :class:`ValueError`. Init-time only; changing requires recreating the renderer. Default: :attr:`SelectionFillMode.GLOBAL`.

name: enable_geometry_streaming
description: Enable geometry streaming. Disabled by default when `None`.

name: enable_geometry_streaming_lod
description: Geometry streaming LOD opt-in config entry.

name: enable_spg
description: Set to False to disable Sensor Processing Graphs (SPG), enabled by default. This is a global setting, applying to all active renderer instances.

name: suppress_deprecation_warnings
description: Suppress Python and native runtime warnings emitted by deprecated OVRTX APIs. Compile-time deprecation diagnostics for C and C++ consumers are unaffected. When `None` or `False`, runtime deprecation warnings remain enabled.

name: motion_bvh
description: Motion BVH mode for sensor pipelines (lidar, radar, acoustic). Accepts a :class:`MotionBvh` member, the equivalent `int` value (`0..2`), or the strings `"disable"`, `"enable"`, or `"auto"`. When `None` (default), motion BVH is disabled and no config entry is sent. Sensor workflows should pass :attr:`MotionBvh.AUTO` or :attr:`MotionBvh.ENABLE`. Init-time only; changing requires recreating the renderer.

name: sensors_allowed_deprecation_base
description: Allow all soft-deprecated sensor versions while pinned to a specific release: `"<major>.<minor>.<patch>"` (e.g. `"0.4.0"`). Soft-deprecated versions are rejected by default; deprecation is allowed only when this matches the current framework version, so it must be revisited on every framework upgrade.

name: aftermath_mode
description: NVIDIA Nsight Aftermath diagnostics mode. Accepts an :class:`AftermathMode` member, the equivalent `int` value (`0..2`), or `"disable"`, `"enable"`, or `"auto"`. Disable skips Aftermath initialization, enable selects explicit diagnostics initialization, and `None` or auto selects the initialization mode automatically. This setting is process-global and must match the first renderer while the renderer system is alive.

name: texture_streaming_mode
description: Texture streaming mode. Accepts a :class:`TextureStreamingMode` member, the equivalent `int` value (`0..2`), or the strings `"disable"`, `"synchronous"`, or `"asynchronous"`. When `None`, asynchronous mode is used. Synchronous mode controls texture-feedback processing; it does not make all texture loading operations synchronous. This setting is process-global and applies to all active renderer instances.
